mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cfg_change(object_type, target_key, before_json, after_json, actor_id, reason, trace_id) VALUES (#{objectType}, #{targetKey}, CAST(#{beforeJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{afterJson} AS jsonb), #{actorId}, #{reason}, #{traceId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, object_type AS objectType, target_key AS targetKey, before_json AS beforeJson, after_json AS afterJson, actor_id AS actorId, reason, created_at AS createdAt, trace_id AS traceId FROM cfg_change WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at <= #{to} ORDER BY created_at, id
